newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower on weak cash, export demand.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower on weak cash, export demand.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended lower on Tuesday, pressured by weak cash and export demand, traders said.

Floor sources said cash markets remained quiet but some sources held out hope that Costa Rica would purchase U.S. supplies in Wednesday's tender. Costa Rica is seeking 30,000 tonnes optional origin rough rice which would likely be from the United States or Argentina, U.S. exporters said.
New crop dealings were active amid continued concerns of planting delays in Texas. Rains had subsided but pit sources said flood waters had not yet receded.
Rice ended 7-1/2 to one cent per cwt lower with May off seven cents at $11.61.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 50 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 336 lots.
